name: shababuna-commerce
description: SHABABUNA — global basketball retail, custom manufacturing, teams and wholesale platform.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && node scripts/check-source.mjs && node scripts/lint-project.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src api e2e tests scripts --fix && node scripts/check-source.mjs && node scripts/lint-project.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:node && npm run coverage:project
scripts.qa: npm run qa:fast && npm run test:ui && npm run coverage:project && npm run build && npm run analyze
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.lighthouse: npm run build && npm run lighthouse:mobile && npm run lighthouse:desktop && npm run lighthouse:validate
scripts.qa:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict-critical && npm run typecheck:production && npm run audit:typescript && npm run test:node && npm run coverage:node && npm run verify:source
scripts.qa:full: npm run qa && npm run test:db && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y && npm run visual && npm run test:pwa-upgrade && npm run security:audit && npm run lighthouse && npm run pagespeed && npm run test:integrations && npm run verify:release
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && npm run test:a11y:run
scripts.verify:release: npm run release:evidence && npm run release:evidence:verify && node scripts/verify-production-release.mjs
scripts.visual: npm run build && npm run visual:run
scripts.security:audit: node scripts/security-audit.mjs && node scripts/run-dependency-audit.mjs && npm run security:sbom
scripts.lint:eslint: eslint src api e2e tests scripts --max-warnings=0
scripts.verify:source: npm run validate:data && npm run validate:commerce && npm run validate:brand && npm run validate:media && npm run validate:seo && npm run validate:cloud-readiness && npm run validate:world-class && npm run validate:performance-budget && npm run validate:static-integrity && npm run validate:final-hardening && npm run validate:catalog-completeness && npm run validate:factory-readiness && npm run validate:arabic-review && npm run validate:provider-readiness && npm run validate:visual-baselines && npm run validate:action-pinning && npm run test:core && node scripts/check-source.mjs
scripts.visual:run: npm run validate:visual-baselines && node scripts/run-browser-tests.mjs e2e/visual.spec.js
scripts.pagespeed: npm run pagespeed:mobile && npm run pagespeed:desktop && npm run pagespeed:validate
scripts.test:e2e:staging-live: npm run test:e2e:isolation && STAGING_LIVE_E2E=true node scripts/run-browser-tests.mjs e2e/staging-live-workflows.spec.js
